policy: First-hand inspection of all 19 open Hotspawn CS2 fixture match pages on egamersworld.com. Only pages publishing a verbatim EGWxxxBOT leading-bookmakers average-odds sentence with non-identical decimal odds in (1.01, 100.0] and paired margin inside [0.85, 1.35] enter entries[]; all 15 placeholder (1.8/1.8) or prose-less pages enter rejected[]. Never overrides a first-party market or esportsbook quote.

entries.excerpt: According to leading bookmakers predictions, the team Off Chops are the favorite with average odds 1.24 at the moment. Respectively, bookmakers consider Ground Zero to be the outsider of the match with odds on a victory in the sum of about 3.44.
entries.note: First-hand EGW match-page capture (EGWxxxBOT bookmaker-average prose). Never overrides first-party Polymarket or Thunderpick quotes; serves as <8h money-backed fallback if first-party books widen or drop.

entries.excerpt: At the moment, the majority of bookmakers unanimously see the team NEXVOID as the favorite of the game with average odds on a victory in the sum of 1.576. Alter Ego chances to prevail are evaluated with average odds 2.19 by bookmakers.
